name: create-lark-startup-wiki
description: Scaffold a Lark Wiki management repo for your startup

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const src=p.resolve('../../templates'),dst=p.resolve('./templates');if(!fs.existsSync(src))throw new Error('templates not found at '+src);fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('copied',src,'->',dst);"

author: saucevn
